description: This PHP source file defines the PostAuthOptionProvider class, which provides access token options for OAuth2 client authentication, including methods to generate request options and the body for token requests.

classes.name: PostAuthOptionProvider
classes.description: Provides options for OAuth2 access token requests, specifically tailored for post-authentication scenarios.

methods.name: getAccessTokenOptions
methods.description: Generates the options array for the access token request based on HTTP method and parameters.

methods.name: getAccessTokenBody
methods.description: Constructs the request body payload for obtaining an access token, using URL-encoded query string format.
